data.name: Description
data.value: Prepare local AI for this ONNX block. Other models compatible with the block’s ONNX runtime can use a matching Python script via Tools > Manage input files. This assistant configures the project; download or export runs at the next execution.

data.name: MemoryNote
data.value: Sizes are estimates for CPU packages. Memory use and speed depend on context length, hardware and provider. GPU execution requires compatible drivers and runtimes. CPU is the default.

data.name: Success
data.value: Local AI setup completed. Save the project. The model will be downloaded or exported at the next execution; an existing model will be reused.

data.name: Qwen3InstructDescription
data.value: Multilingual text generation, document questions and keyword extraction. A compact INT4 option for local workflows.

data.name: Qwen3InstructDetails
data.value: CPU download: about 2.6 GB · Plan for roughly 6–8 GB RAM or more, depending on context. CPU, CUDA or DirectML.

data.name: Phi4MiniDescription
data.value: Multilingual general-purpose text generation and instructions. INT4 model; CPU execution trades speed for broad hardware support.

data.name: Phi4MiniDetails
data.value: CPU download: about 4.9 GB · Plan for roughly 6–8 GB RAM or more, depending on context. CPU, CUDA or DirectML.

data.name: ExtractiveQADescription
data.value: mDeBERTa SQuAD2 extracts an answer directly from supplied text. Suitable for short factual answers; does not generate free-form responses.

data.name: ExtractiveQADetails
data.value: Portable ONNX export · Model files exceed 1 GB; export needs additional disk space and RAM. CPU, CUDA or DirectML at runtime.

data.name: Step1Description
data.value: Check compatibility, bundled script availability and existing provider fields before changing the project.

data.name: Step2Description
data.value: Reuse a suitable mapped input or create OnnxProvider with CPU as the default and a provider selection list.

data.name: Step3Description
data.value: Add or update the project input script and pass the provider input to its startup command.

data.name: Step4Description
data.value: Link the shared provider input to the ONNX block.

data.name: GlobalChangeNote
data.value: Created or updated globally outside the current transaction. Cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z; cancelling the property editor keeps these changes.

data.name: OverwriteExistingTooltip
data.value: Allow replacing an existing selection or conflicting configuration in this step.

data.name: SaveBlockRequired
data.value: Setup is only complete after saving the ONNX FlowBlock in the property editor.

data.name: Step5Description
data.value: Set the model folder and, for GenAI, the matching chat template. Existing prompt text is retained.
